##[error]Process completed with exit code 1.
root_cause: The Android build uses -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON (or equivalent via the toolchain/genai extra modules), but ov_generate_plugins_hpp() unconditionally calls ov_target_link_plugins(openvino) at plugins.cmake:325-327 even for shared-lib builds. The ov_target_link_plugins function contains an early return guard for BUILD_SHARED_LIBS (line ~264), but calling ov_target_link_plugins from ov_generate_plugins_hpp bypasses the intent - or an EXTRA_MODULE (openvino.genai) changes the plugin type to MODULE_LIBRARY which is not linkable. The PR #37304 (NPUW sliding-window matcher fix) does not touch CMake files, so this is a pre-existing CMake issue with the Android extra-modules configuration, likely exposed by the openvino.genai extra modules registration making plugins MODULE_LIBRARY targets.
reproduction_steps: Run the Android CMake configure step with -DOPENVINO_EXTRA_MODULES=<openvino.genai> and -DENABLE_INTEL_NPU=ON against the master branch.
recommended_actions: Inspect cmake/extra_modules.cmake:186 and how ov_generate_plugins_hpp interacts with extra modules that register MODULE_LIBRARY plugin targets.
Add a guard in ov_generate_plugins_hpp (or ov_target_link_plugins) to skip MODULE_LIBRARY targets, similar to the BUILD_SHARED_LIBS guard.
Check if this failure is pre-existing on master (unrelated to PR #37304) by running the same Android workflow on master alone.
File a bug if confirmed pre-existing; if introduced by a recent merge, identify and revert the CMake change.
prevention_strategies: Add CI validation that ov_generate_plugins_hpp works correctly when EXTRA_MODULES register MODULE_LIBRARY targets. Consider adding a CMake check that rejects MODULE_LIBRARY plugin registrations when static linking is needed.
historical_context: No prior occurrences of this exact failure found in the pattern database.
